description: Three separate one-in one-out jack pairs, all applying the same function, which one knob chooses

params.text: Chooses the function all three pairs apply: 10-x subtracts the input from 10V, -x negates it, |x| makes it positive, Relu replaces anything below 0V with 0V, and Σoid is a sigmoid between -5V and 5V

inputs.text: One of three inputs, each worked on by itself, channel by channel

outputs.text: Carries its own input with the chosen function applied, with the same number of channels

notes: an output is written only while a cable is patched to the input it belongs to, so unpatching an input leaves its output frozen at the last voltage it carried
the lamp beside a function's name marks the one the knob has chosen
